note: Reviewed Silver rules for the PSA school-age population census workbooks (#158, D-053). The generator src/silver/psa_school_age_population.py writes etl/03_silver/08_clean_psa_school_age_population.sql, etl/03_silver/90_validate_psa_school_age_population_clean.sql and docs/data/silver/psa-school-age-population-clean.md from this file and config/ingestion/psa_school_age_population.json. Change a rule here, then regenerate; tests/test_silver_school_age.py fails until the files match.

grain.rule: One row per count cell: census year, population concept (the sheet), place, sex and single-year age 5-24. The 2020 wide rows (60 counts) and the 2024 Total / Male / Female rows (20 counts each) give the same grain.

population_concept.rule: From the sheet: '<year> Total Pop' is total, '<year> Household Pop' is household (the contract's sheet_suffixes). Both are kept, never mixed (D-029).

label.rule: place_label keeps the published label, whitespace normalized. footnote is a trailing marker such as '1/' or 'a/'. is_capital is TRUE when a bracket holds Capital in any case. old_name is the text of every other bracket, ', '-separated (mostly an old name; for a region, its abbreviation). place_name drops the marker and every bracket, then upper-cases.

levels.rule: A place is an aggregate when the places right after it add up to it in all 60 cells, each nested aggregate counted once; its children are those places. An aggregate's level is its depth (country, region, province); a place with no children is a city or municipality, under a province (depth 3) or directly under its region (depth 2). Any other shape gets no level and the gate fails. The level is the place's position in the tree, not a verified PSGC geographic level: place_status marks the places at a province or city position that are not PSGC provinces or LGUs.

place_status.rule: standard for every place but these. special_geographic_area: the 2020 INTERIM PROVINCE and the 2024 SPECIAL GEOGRAPHIC AREA, at the province position but not a PSGC province (PSGC Silver keeps the SGA with no level, level_blank). sga_cluster: a 2020 place under it whose name ends in CLUSTER (with an optional Roman numeral): PSA's grouping of the SGA barangays by former Cotabato town, not an LGU, with no PSGC counterpart. The level stays the tree position, so the pinned level counts still hold; the counts per status are pinned too. The 8 SGA municipalities of 2024 are PSGC municipalities and stay standard.

count.rule: Whole numbers as stored become INT. Zero stays 0, a real count (Kalayaan, O-3). A blank, negative or other value quarantines the cell, and any quarantined cell fails the gate: every count is complete in the profile.
